children: Palm oil fell during the Asian trading session. Prices were likely pressured by overnight weakness in rival soy oil, Kenanga Futures writes in a note. Data from cargo surveyor AmSpec Agri Malaysia estimated that Malaysia's palm oil exports during the Sept. 1-10 period fell 17% on month, indicating weaker demand. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for November delivery fell 81 ringgit to 4,885 ringgit a ton. (kimberley.kao@wsj.com)
